q: A sound level meter reads $80\,\text{dB}$. What is the intensity of the sound?
Three identical machines are running in a workshop, each producing $80\,\text{dB}$ alone at the meter. What is the combined level?
a: The intensities add up: $I = 3 \cdot 1.0 \cdot 10^{-4}\,\text{W/m}^2$, so $L = 80\,\text{dB} + 10\,\text{dB} \cdot \lg 3 \approx 84.8\,\text{dB}$, not $240\,\text{dB}$.
